tasks.text: You want to start putting 500 ₪ a month into the S&P 500, with nothing put in at the start. A friend sent you this website. Find where it is cheapest to do this, and how much you would have after ten years.

where.description: Where you would do it: the bank or company, as the page names it

fund.description: Which fund, if the page told you; empty if you do not know

amount_after_10_years.description: How much you would have after ten years, in shekels; null if you did not find it

answerKey.right: Psagot (פסגות), with the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) tracking fund; about 72,100 ₪ after ten years, with nothing put in at the start and the page's 7% a year (checked on the live site 2026-11-05)
answerKey.partly: Psagot with another amount (129,913 ₪ is the page's default, which has 10,000 ₪ put in at the start), or about 72,100 ₪ with another account
